notes.title: Major update for True Boxing VR
notes.notes: I have been been working hard on bringing this update to life. The code has been optimized as well as the characters. In  order to reach more than 72FPS, I had redo all characters, lowering the polycount, and reduce texture sizes to increase the performance. The FPS is now low enough to provide good player experience. In order to get performance up for the boxing experience I removed all objects not necessary. I made the choice to not have any audience in the scenes in favour to a smoother gaming experience.

notes.title: Update content
notes.notes:
New in this update:
-Difficulty level improved (yes, it is a bit more difficult  in this version)
-Hit effects on both opponent and player
-Field of view of the player becomes red around the edges as the player gets hurt.
-Opponents face gets hurt as he gets hit. (only opponent 1 at this stage)
-Logic improved, and the oppoent is more agressive.
-Sound effects improved.

NEXT Update:
